events.title: Australian Market Trims Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is trimming its early losses in mid-market moves on Thursday, snapping a three-session winning streak, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling to near the 8,700 level, with weakness in mining, financial and technology stocks partially offset by energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Track Wall Street Lower
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly lower on Thursday, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, as a rebound in crude oil prices and surging bond yields renewed global inflation risks and interest rate hike concerns amid uncertainty in the resolution of the Middle East conflict and the reopening of the critical Strait of Hormuz. Asian markets closed mixed on Wednesday.

events.title: Indian Shares Likely To Drift Lower As Oil And Bond Yields Rise
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening lower on Thursday after oil prices rose sharply overnight and U.S. bond yields jumped to their highest levels in nearly two decades, raising the possibility of another interest-rate hike from the Federal Reserve this year.

events.title: Rally May Stall For Thai Stock Market
events.description: The Thai stock market has moved higher in five straight sessions, collecting almost 50 points or 3.1 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,610-point plateau although it's likely to open to the downside on Thursday.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Turn Lower Again On Thursday
events.description: The Indonesia stock market on Wednesday ended the three-day slide in which it had tumbled almost 190 points or 3 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just beneath the 6,375-point plateau although it may head south again on Thursday.

events.title: Japanese Market Sharply Higher
events.description: The Japanese market is sharply higher in post-holiday trading on Thursday, extending the gains in the previous three sessions, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving well above the 66,150 level, with gains in index heavyweights, exporters and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in financial stocks.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market May Take Further Damage On Thursday
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market halted the three-day winning streak in which it had jumped more than 480 points or 1.9 percent. The Hang Seng Index now sits just above the 24,830-point plateau and it's tipped to open in the red again on Thursday.

events.title: China Stock Market May Extend Wednesday's Losses
events.description: The China stock market on Wednesday wrote a finish to the three-day winning streak in which it had advanced more than 75 points or 1.7 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,935-point plateau and the losses may accelerate on Thursday.

events.title: Japan Manufacturing PMI Slows To 54.1 In September - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in Japan continued to expand in September, albeit at a slower pace, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Thursday with a manufacturing PMI score of 54.1.

events.title: Australian Market Sharply Lower
events.description: The Australian market is sharply lower on Thursday, snapping a three-session winning streak, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling to near the 8,650 level, with weakness in mining, financial and technology stocks partially offset by energy stocks.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market Overdue For Profit Taking
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has tracked higher in six straight sessions, surging more than 3,250 points or 7.2 percent along the way. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 48,150-point plateau although investors are likely to cash in on Thursday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market Tipped To Open Under Pressure
events.description: The Singapore stock market on Wednesday ended the two-day winning streak in which it had gathered almost 70 points or 1.2 percent. The Straits Times Index now sits just beneath the 5,710-point plateau and it may take further damage on Thursday.

events.title: Continued Consolidation Seen For Malaysia Stock Market
events.description: The Malaysia stock market on Wednesday snapped the two-day winning streak in which it had collected almost 20 points or 1.2 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,675-point plateau and it may extend its losses on Thursday.
